# deps: tools: add gorelease

Add `gorelease` (`golang.org/x/exp/cmd/gorelease`) to the Go toolset. **Motivation:** "it's experimental feature now" — the tool that checks a module's API against its last release and proposes the next version; related to [octomation/go-module#45](https://github.com/octomation/go-module/issues/45), the author's Go project template.

```go
_ "golang.org/x/exp/cmd/gorelease"

//go:generate go install golang.org/x/exp/cmd/gorelease
```
